_note: Hand-written messages in the shape an email connector returns (sender, subject, snippet, date, id, link). Every company, person and address is fictional.

greenhouse_rejection.subject: Your application to Northwind Health
greenhouse_rejection.snippet: Hi Jordan, thank you for your interest in the Clinical Operations Manager role at Northwind Health. After careful review, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our needs.

ashby_acknowledgement.subject: Thanks for applying to Juniper Learning!
ashby_acknowledgement.snippet: We have received your application for Instructional Designer and our team will review it. This is an automated message; please do not reply.
